name: ns1-securescan
description: Honesty-first SAST scanner. One engine, two shells: a CLI and a browser UI. Every finding is labelled signature-based or flow-verified, and a verified one prints the path that proves it.

scripts.scan: npm run build --silent && node dist/src/cli.js scan
scripts.ast: npm run build --silent && node dist/src/cli.js ast
scripts.doctor: npm run build --silent && node dist/src/cli.js doctor
scripts.rules: npm run build --silent && node dist/src/cli.js rules
scripts.ui: npm run build --silent && node scripts/build-ui.mjs && node scripts/serve-ui.mjs
